solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Bet on party for distinguished old lady

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece on another is placed after it

parts.note: a do is an informal word for a party or celebration
a bet is a wager

explanation.surface: Someone stakes money on which party an elderly grande dame will attend.
explanation.definitionFit: A dowager is a widow holding a title from her late husband, hence a dignified elderly woman.

clue.text: Theatre doctor with a degree

parts.note: an MA, Master of Arts, is a university degree

explanation.surface: A medic with a qualification working in the theatre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Theatre' suggests an operating theatre beside a doctor; it means stage plays.
explanation.definitionFit: Drama is the art of plays and acting, the theatre as a whole.

clue.text: Parking booked after spring is still looking good

indicators.note: after places the parking and booked pieces following the spring

parts.note: a well is a spring of water
P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking
booked means reserved in advance

explanation.surface: A reserved parking spot by a spa spring for someone who looks youthful.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone well-preserved shows few signs of age, still in good condition.

clue.text: Gone around a port in Italy

indicators.note: around shows the letters of gone are moved about

explanation.surface: Someone has travelled round an Italian harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Genoa is a major seaport on Italy's northwest coast.

clue.text: Firm removing power and millions from promoted

indicators.note: removing means the named letters are taken out of the word promoted

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for power in physics
M stands for million or millions

explanation.surface: A company sheds its powerful and wealthy executives after promotion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Firm' looks like a company, but it means fixed solidly.
explanation.definitionFit: Something rooted is firmly fixed in place, like a plant with established roots.

clue.text: Make an effort initially to include ultraviolet and purple

indicators.note: to include means the first-letter group wraps around the other piece
initially asks for the opening letter of each of the words Make an effort

parts.note: UV is the standard abbreviation for ultraviolet light

explanation.surface: Instructions for a painter to work some ultraviolet into a purple shade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to include' puts UV inside MAE, the first letters of Make an effort.
explanation.definitionFit: Mauve is a pale shade of purple, named after the mallow flower's colour.

clue.text: My penning lyric poems with little time for humility

indicators.note: penning means enclosing, as animals in a pen, so the word my surrounds the rest

parts.note: odes are lyric poems
T is the short form of time

explanation.surface: A poet writing lyrics and modestly claiming little time for them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'penning' reads as writing, but it means enclosing.
explanation.definitionFit: Modesty is a lack of vanity, a humble estimation of oneself.

clue.text: Dull university wise men with local

parts.note: the Magi were the wise men of the Nativity
a native is a local inhabitant

explanation.surface: A boring university meeting of sages with a local resident.
explanation.definitionFit: An unimaginative thing lacks creativity and so is dull and uninspired.

clue.text: Making smooth transition from day into night

definitions.meaning: levelling a surface, flattening it out
the period at the close of day as darkness falls

explanation.surface: A smooth changeover from daylight to darkness.
explanation.definitionFit: Evening a surface makes it level, and the evening is the time between day and night.

clue.text: In due course, exhausted by enjoyment?

indicators.note: by here means next to, so the enjoyment piece sits beside the exhausted piece

parts.note: all in is a colloquial phrase for completely tired out
a good time is a spell of fun or enjoyment

explanation.surface: Asks whether, eventually, one gets worn out from having too much fun.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases mean eventually, at the proper moment, without hurrying things along.

clue.text: Placate monkey, feeding it vegetables

indicators.note: the vegetables go into the monkey, as food into its mouth

parts.note: an ape is a primate, loosely a monkey; to ape is also to monkey about
peas are green vegetables

explanation.surface: Calm an angry zoo monkey by giving it some vegetables to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: To placate and to appease both mean to calm someone by meeting their demands.

clue.text: Got into deep water with one religious teacher

parts.note: taken literally, getting into deep water means swimming, so swam
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A spiritual guide who ended up in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Got into deep water' suggests getting into difficulties; here it means literally swimming.
explanation.definitionFit: A swami is a Hindu holy man and spiritual instructor.

clue.text: Make drawing of small sailing vessel

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a ketch is a two-masted sailing boat

explanation.surface: A request to draw a picture of a little boat.
explanation.definitionFit: To sketch is to make a rough drawing of something.

clue.text: Small bird sings rhythmically up on bank

indicators.note: in a down clue, on places the first piece above the other
in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: raps means delivers rhythmic spoken lyrics
a bank is a row, as of switches or seats

explanation.surface: A little bird chirps tunefully perched on a riverbank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bank' suggests a riverbank; it means a row, as in a bank of lights.
explanation.definitionFit: The sparrow is a small brown songbird, common in towns.

clue.text: Exclusive group takes old cottage on Great Lake

indicators.note: in a down clue, on places the cottage above the lake

parts.note: cot is an archaic word for a small cottage
Lake Erie is one of North America's Great Lakes

explanation.surface: A select set acquires a vintage lakeside cabin.
explanation.definitionFit: A coterie is a small, exclusive circle of people with shared interests.

clue.text: Misplaced pity, no good initially for composing text?

indicators.note: the letters of pity are put in the wrong places, rearranged
initially takes the first letters of no and good

explanation.surface: Sympathy shown in the wrong place, with nothing good coming of it at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Misplaced' rearranges PITY to TYPI; 'initially' gives NG from no good.
explanation.definitionFit: Keying words in on a keyboard is producing written text, though not composing in the creative sense, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Car with parts of boot?

parts.note: heels are the raised rear parts of boots

explanation.surface: A car together with bits of its boot, the British word for trunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boot' suggests a car's luggage space (British for trunk); it is footwear.
explanation.definitionFit: Wheels is slang for a car, one's own transport.

clue.text: A branch of government briefly showing proficiency

parts.note: dept is the short form of department, a branch of government

explanation.surface: A civil service department demonstrating real competence.
explanation.definitionFit: An adept person is skilled and expert, so they show proficiency.

clue.text: Shun bad dancing partner

indicators.note: the letters of Shun bad move around as if dancing

explanation.surface: Someone avoids a poor dance partner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'partner' looks like a dancing partner, but it is the definition, a spouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A married man is his wife's partner in life.

clue.text: Health resort in European country

parts.note: a spa is a resort with mineral springs for health

explanation.surface: A wellness retreat located in a European country.
explanation.definitionFit: Spain is a country in southwestern Europe.

clue.text: Slow learner caught dipping into Herbert's sci-fi classic

indicators.note: dipping into means the letter goes inside the title

parts.note: Dune is Frank Herbert's 1965 science-fiction novel
C is the cricket scoring abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A weak pupil is spotted browsing a famous science-fiction novel.
explanation.definitionFit: A dunce is a pupil who is slow to learn.

clue.text: Always be in right allotment for lasting reflection

indicators.note: in places the first pieces inside the others

parts.note: a ration is a fixed allotted share
ever means always, as in ever hopeful

explanation.surface: Musings on always being right, perhaps about a garden plot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'allotment' looks like a British vegetable plot, but here it means a share.
explanation.definitionFit: A reverberation is an echo, sound that persists by reflecting off surfaces.

clue.text: Golf club's tungsten rim

parts.note: W is the chemical symbol for tungsten, from wolfram
a rim is an edge

explanation.surface: A golf club with a tungsten edge.
explanation.definitionFit: A wedge is a steeply lofted iron used in golf for short high shots.

clue.text: Because religious education is true

parts.note: since can mean because, as in since you ask
RE is the school subject Religious Education in Britain

explanation.surface: A claim that something is true because of religious teaching.
explanation.definitionFit: Sincere means genuine and heartfelt, as in true friendship.
